name: Autumn Grove
description: Wander through an enchanted autumn forest and gather nature's treasures as the seasons change. A peaceful collection experience with falling leaves, forest spirits, and magical autumn items.
author: Wavelength Consulting
features: Magical autumn forest with falling leaves and treasures
Collection system with rarity tiers (common to legendary)
Dynamic seasonal effects and visual magic
Contemplative 45-second badge timing for peaceful gameplay
Ambient forest atmosphere with gentle interactions

technical.performance: Optimized for mobile with efficient particle cleanup
